description: This file defines structures, enums, and function prototypes for handling git trailers, including parsing, formatting, and modifying trailer data in commit messages and files.

classes.name: trailer_iterator
classes.description: Iterator for traversing trailers in a commit message.

methods.name: trailer_iterator_init
methods.description: Initializes the trailer iterator for a given commit message.

methods.name: trailer_iterator_advance
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next trailer.

methods.name: trailer_iterator_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with the trailer iterator.
